newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH COOPERATIVE BANKS AGREE ON NEW STRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH COOPERATIVE BANKS AGREE ON NEW STRUCTURE.

text.p: The Finnish co-operative banks and OKOBANK on Tuesday agreed on a new structure for the co-operative banking group, OKOBANK said in a statement.
Osuuspankkien Keskusliitto (OKL) would become a cooperative called Osuuspankkikeskus Osuuskunta. OKOBANK and the regional banks would be its members, it said.
"The (new) cooperative will own over 50 percent of the votes in OKOBANK which will remain central bank for the cooperative banks," it said.
The changes would not affect the financial status of any part of the group of co-operative banks, it said.
